title: 云厂商加速AI基础设施军备竞赛，智能代理与安全成为差异化竞争新焦点
core_insight: 云厂商正从基础设施提供商向AI应用生态构建者转型，通过专用AI芯片、分布式架构和安全工具链升级，推动Agentic AI在垂直行业规模化落地

dimension_texts.technology: Google Cloud推出多集群GKE推理网关支持跨集群AI工作负载调度；AWS推出OpenClaw on Amazon Lightsail强化云原生AI部署；Cloudflare通过RFC 9457兼容错误响应机制优化AI代理交互效率 Google Cloud发布Ironwood TPU专门针对万亿参数模型训练；Cloudflare Gen13服务器性能提升2倍；AWS将NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Super引入Amazon Bedrock Introducing multi-cluster GKE Inference Gateway: Scale AI workloads around the world A developer’s guide to training with Ironwood TPUs Introducing OpenClaw on Amazon Lightsail to run your autonomous private AI agents Launching Cloudflare’s Gen 13 servers: trading cache for cores for 2x edge compute performance Slashing agent token costs by 98% with RFC 9457-compliant error responses AWS Weekly Roundup: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Super on Amazon Bedrock, Nova Forge SDK, Amazon Corretto 26, and more Many agents, one team: Scaling modernization on Azure Next-gen caching with Memorystore for Valkey 9.0, now GA AI Security for Apps is now generally available Powering the agents: Workers AI now runs large models, starting with Kimi K2.5
